existingInfrastructure.description: This PRD assumes integration with an existing project that has basic authentication already implemented
availableCapabilities: Basic user model with unique identifiers

integrationApproach.principle: Leverage and extend the existing auth system rather than building from scratch
guidelines: All new role and permission features should build on top of existing user accounts
Club membership and roles are an extension layer, not a replacement for base auth
Reuse existing session tokens and authentication middleware
Player profiles link to existing user accounts when a user claims their profile
Audit logging should integrate with any existing logging infrastructure

problemStatement.summary: Most tennis clubs run tournaments using spreadsheets, PDFs, whiteboards, or fragmented tools
painPoints: Cannot handle multiple tournament formats cleanly
Error-prone when scores change or disputes occur
Require manual draw updates and recalculation of standings
Poor mobile usability for courtside score entry
Difficult for players to follow in real time

productVision.statement: Create a multi-tenant SaaS platform that enables tennis clubs to run tournaments and competitions end-to-end with confidence, clarity, and minimal admin effort
principles: Simple enough for social comps, robust enough for serious tournaments
Support public viewing and optional player accounts

mvp.metric: Time to create and publish a tournament

personas.name: Club Admin
personas.description: Sets up club, manages roles and permissions

personas.name: Player
personas.description: Views fixtures and results, optionally submits scores

multiTenantAndClubAdministration.implementationNote: This epic extends the existing authentication system. User accounts, login, and session management are already implemented. These features add club/tenant membership and role-based permissions on top of the existing user model.

stories.title: Create a club (tenant)
stories.userStory: As a platform admin, I can create a new club tenant with name, region, and branding basics
acceptanceCriteria: Club has unique ID and isolated data namespace
Default roles exist (Admin, Organiser, Supervisor, Player)
Branding defaults applied (logo/color optional)

stories.title: Invite users to a club
stories.userStory: As a club admin, I can invite users via email to join my club and assign a role
acceptanceCriteria: Invite can be accepted/declined
Roles are per-club
A user can belong to multiple clubs
Leverages existing user accounts - invited users log in with existing credentials
New users go through the existing registration flow before accepting invite

stories.title: Manage club members & roles
stories.userStory: As a club admin, I can view and change roles of members and deactivate access
acceptanceCriteria: Role changes take effect immediately
Deactivated users lose club access but remain users globally
Changes are logged in an audit log

stories.title: Configure club defaults
stories.userStory: As a club admin, I can set default scoring rule presets, naming conventions, and optional ratings provider settings
acceptanceCriteria: Defaults apply to newly created competitions
Existing competitions are unaffected unless explicitly updated

exitCriteria: Two clubs can exist and cannot see each other's data
Existing authenticated users can be invited to clubs without re-registering
Club role permissions layer works alongside existing auth middleware

stories.title: Create a competition/event
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can create a competition with name, type (tournament/league), format (KO/RR/etc.), dates (optional), and status (draft/published)
acceptanceCriteria: Draft competitions are not visible to players/public
Published competitions are visible via link (read-only)

stories.title: Configure divisions/grades
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can create one or more divisions (e.g., A grade, B grade), each with its own draw
acceptanceCriteria: Each division can have its own format/scoring rules (optional override)
A player/team can only belong to one division per competition (unless explicitly enabled later)

stories.title: Configure scoring rules
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can choose a scoring preset or define a custom scoring rule
acceptanceCriteria: Custom rule can be saved to competition (and optionally as club preset)
Score entry UI validates against selected rule
scoringPresets: Custom (e.g., 1 set first to 8 games, tiebreak at 7-7)

stories.title: Configure score-entry permissions
stories.userStory: As a club admin or organiser, I can set who can enter scores: organisers/supervisors only, or allow players with mutual confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: If player scoring enabled: only match participants can submit/confirm
Match is not final until both participants approve (or admin overrides)
All actions are audit logged

stories.title: Publish competition
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can publish a competition to generate a shareable public link
acceptanceCriteria: Public link is read-only by default
Public link can be disabled/regenerated
Logged-in players see the same info plus their personal views

exitCriteria: Organiser can create KO/RR competition with custom 'first to 8 games' ruleset

stories.title: Add players to a competition
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can add players by searching existing club player profiles or creating a new profile
acceptanceCriteria: Player profiles can exist without a user login
Duplicate detection suggests possible matches (name/email)
A player can be reused across competitions

stories.title: Edit player details
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can edit a player's details and assign them to a division
acceptanceCriteria: Changes reflect immediately in the competition
Audit record created for key changes (division, name, identifier)

stories.title: Create doubles teams
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can create a doubles team from two players and register it to a division
acceptanceCriteria: Prevent the same player being in two teams in same division (unless explicitly allowed)
Teams have display names and can store seeding/rating metadata

stories.title: Bulk import players
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can import players/teams from CSV
acceptanceCriteria: CSV template provided
Preview + validation before commit
Import report shows created/updated/skipped entries

exitCriteria: Organiser can build an entry list for singles or doubles

enginePrinciples: Determinism: Generation must be repeatable (same inputs + seed = same fixtures)
Immutability of history: Store each generation as a revision
Event-sourcing-friendly: Engine can run from state snapshot or domain events
Pluggable formats: Each format implements validate, generate, update progression
Scoring is declarative: Validation uses RuleSet, not scattered if/else

stories.title: Generate knockout draw
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can generate a knockout draw from registered entries with optional seeding and byes
acceptanceCriteria: Supports bracket sizes not equal to power-of-two (byes assigned)
Seed placement follows standard seeding distribution rules
Regenerating requires confirmation and logs the action

steps: Compute number of byes = bracketSize - entryCount
Build initial slots with seeding placement if enabled
Fill remaining with unseeded (optionally shuffle with RNG)
Create round-1 matches in slot order
Create subsequent rounds as PENDING with WINNER_OF_MATCH source

stories.title: Generate round robin fixtures
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can generate round robin fixtures for a division as a single pool or multiple pools
acceptanceCriteria: Fixtures cover all required matchups (each pair plays once, or configurable)
Pool size and number of pools can be set
Optional finals stage can be configured

poolAssignment: If distributeSeeds: sort by seed ascending, snake distribution across pools
Fill remaining entries with deterministic shuffle, distribute round-robin
fixtureGeneration: Use circle method to generate rounds for N participants per pool
If odd N: add ghost BYE participant, generate rounds, omit BYE matches

stories.title: Generate Swiss pairings
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can generate Swiss rounds based on results and pairing rules
acceptanceCriteria: Prevent repeated pairings where possible
Supports round count configuration
Pairing algorithm is deterministic and auditable

stories.title: Generate ladder/box league rounds
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can generate scheduled rounds or enable challenge-based ladder rules
acceptanceCriteria: Ladder rule set is configurable (movement logic, challenge windows)
Results update standings automatically

stories.title: Generate compass draw
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can generate a compass draw structure (with directional brackets)
acceptanceCriteria: Losers feed into the correct compass path
Standings/results reflect compass progression

stories.title: Generate team competition fixtures
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can generate team-vs-team fixtures and define match rubbers
acceptanceCriteria: Team tie has a collection of sub-matches
Scoring can roll-up to team result using configured rules

exitCriteria: With 7 entries you can generate RR fixtures correctly
With 13 entries you can generate KO bracket with byes

stories.title: Enter match score (organiser/supervisor)
stories.userStory: As an organiser or supervisor, I can enter a score for a match and mark special outcomes
acceptanceCriteria: Score is validated against scoring rule set
Match state transitions to Completed
Standings/draw updates immediately

stories.title: Player score submission + mutual approval
stories.userStory: As a player, I can submit the score for a match I played, and my opponent can approve or dispute it
acceptanceCriteria: Only participants can submit/approve
Both approvals required to finalise
Dispute blocks finalisation and alerts organisers (in-app)

stories.title: Score corrections & overrides
stories.userStory: As an admin/organiser, I can correct a score after it's entered, with a reason
acceptanceCriteria: Correction requires a reason note
Prior value retained in audit history
Downstream standings/draw recalculated correctly

stories.title: Match status controls
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can mark match statuses: Scheduled, In Progress, Completed, Abandoned, Cancelled
acceptanceCriteria: Status changes are tracked
Completed requires a valid score or special outcome

exitCriteria: Supervisor can record a full day's results from a phone

stories.title: Round robin standings + tie-breakers
stories.userStory: As an organiser/player, I can view standings with configurable tie-breakers
acceptanceCriteria: Tie-breaker order configurable per competition (wins, head-to-head, set %, game %)
Standings update after each completed match

stories.title: Knockout progression
stories.userStory: As an organiser/player, I can see winners advance automatically in the draw
acceptanceCriteria: Completing a match places winner into next-round slot
Walkovers/retirements progress correctly

stories.title: Finals stage after pools
stories.userStory: As an organiser, I can generate a finals bracket from pool results (top N per pool)
acceptanceCriteria: Selection rules configurable (top 2, top 4, best runners-up)
Seeding can be derived from pool ranking

exitCriteria: Completing scores updates next round (KO) or rankings (RR) correctly

stories.title: Public competition view
stories.userStory: As anyone with the link, I can view published fixtures, results, and standings
acceptanceCriteria: Read-only access
No personal data leakage beyond what the club allows (e.g., initials option)

stories.title: Player dashboard
stories.userStory: As a logged-in player, I can see 'My Matches' across all clubs and competitions
acceptanceCriteria: Shows upcoming + pending confirmation + completed
Filters by club/competition

stories.title: Player identity linking
stories.userStory: As a club admin, I can link a user account to an existing player profile to avoid duplicates
acceptanceCriteria: Merge flow has preview and conflict resolution
Links player profile to existing authenticated user account from the auth system
User can also self-claim a player profile if email matches

exitCriteria: Public can follow along without logging in
Logged-in players get personalised match list

stories.title: Player score submission
stories.userStory: As a player, I can submit my match score which creates a pending confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: Only participants can submit
Creates 'pending confirmation' status

stories.title: Mutual approval & dispute
stories.userStory: As the opponent, I can confirm or dispute the submitted score
acceptanceCriteria: Opponent can confirm or dispute
Organiser/admin can override
Dispute goes to organiser to resolve

exitCriteria: Two players can submit/confirm score without organiser involvement
Dispute goes to organiser to resolve

stories.title: Audit log
stories.userStory: As an admin, I can see a timeline of changes (fixtures generated, scores entered/edited, permission changes)
acceptanceCriteria: Records who/when/what (entity + before/after for critical fields)
Filterable by competition/division/match

stories.title: Data export
stories.userStory: As an admin, I can export fixtures, results, standings as CSV
acceptanceCriteria: Export includes IDs for re-import/debug
Works per division and whole competition

features.title: Ratings sync (UTR / Tennis Australia)
features.userStory: As a club admin, I can connect a ratings provider and sync player ratings periodically
acceptanceCriteria: Provider connection stored per club
Sync logs + conflict handling (manual override)
Ratings used in seeding suggestions

features.title: Bracket visual editor (drag/drop UI)
features.userStory: As an organiser, I can visually adjust a bracket/pool via drag and drop with rule warnings
acceptanceCriteria: Drag-drop updates underlying fixture model
Warnings for seeding violations / invalid states
Undo/redo and audit trail

alreadyExists: Basic user model and database schema
outOfScope.note: Features marked 'alreadyExists' are provided by the existing auth system and should be leveraged, not rebuilt

performance: Fixture generation < 1 second for typical club sizes

assumptions: Existing authentication system provides: user registration, login, session management, and user model
Club/tenant features extend (not replace) the existing auth - add membership and roles layer
Player profiles decoupled from user accounts (profiles can exist without login, linked later)
Existing auth middleware should be reused for route protection

pluginContract.description: Each format plugin must implement these methods

set.capAt: number (optional, e.g., 9 for first to 9 no-adv)

mvpReleaseCriteria: A club can run a full KO or RR tournament
Scores can be entered and corrected
Admin override and audit log function

knockoutTournament: Supervisors enter scores as matches finish
Players follow progress via public link

requirements: Create competition wizard is short with sensible defaults
Fixtures generation is 1 click with clear preview + regenerate warning
Can correct a score with a reason
Landing page shows today's/all matches for the division
Tap a match to enter set scores fast (minimal taps)
UI must work in weak reception (simple pages, small payloads)
Public link shows fixtures (by round/pool), results, standings
If player scoring enabled: submit + confirm flows

features: Enter scores + corrections + player mutual approval option (E1-E3)

v1PostMvp.description: Valuable but not needed for first club success
features: Finals stage after pools (top N to KO)

recommended.scope: Multi-tenant + create comp + add players + KO fixtures + score entry + public link
